## About
Payne's Automotive is a family owned and operated repair shop on the corner of Bingle and Tidwell. We work on personal, commercial and fleet vehicles, both domestic and foreign, and our mechanics are qualified on gas and diesel engines using current diagnostic tools.
Before any work starts, you get a price estimate and we wait for your approval. We explain what your vehicle needs, help you decide what comes first, and keep you posted while it's in the shop. Every vehicle gets a computerized service history, and you leave with a detailed invoice to keep.
Our goal is simple: earn your trust, keep you safe on the road, and help you avoid costly repairs down the line.

## Services
- Oil and oil filter service: Routine oil changes to keep your engine running right.
- Air conditioning service: A/C diagnosis and repair to keep you cool through a Houston summer.
- Brake service and repair: Inspection, service and repair of your brake system.
- Transmission service: Service to keep your transmission shifting smoothly.
- Cooling system service: Radiator and cooling system work to keep your engine from overheating.
- Engine service and repair: Engine diagnosis and repair on gas and diesel engines.
- Drivetrain service and repair: Service and repair for the parts that deliver power to your wheels.
- Fleet and commercial vehicles: We service commercial and fleet vehicles along with personal cars and trucks.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on diesel engines and trucks?
A: Yes. Our mechanics are qualified on both gas and diesel engines, and we work on cars and light and medium duty trucks.

Q: Can I see the parts you replaced?
A: Yes. We save all replaced parts until you arrive so you can inspect them if you'd like.

Q: What if my car is still under the dealer's warranty?
A: We'll let you know if a problem we find is still covered under the dealer's warranty.

Q: Are you open on weekends?
A: No. We're open Monday through Friday and closed Saturday and Sunday.
